structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. Harel's page is all about "קופת גמל להשקעה" tracks with shares, nothing like a deposit. The fee is about half a percent a year, but I don't know if that's more than the bank takes, so I'll ask my son or the bank before I move anything.

stuck.why: Many percentages in rows; I couldn't tell whether 24.04% '3 שנים' means every year or all three years together
This looked like the safe bonds, but it had no return, only 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so I couldn't judge it
There was no deposit or fixed-interest choice; I didn't know which one is meant for someone like me
